name: Code Playground — Sharp Glassmorphism
description: Frosted-glass code playground floating over a vibrant animated gradient mesh. A tabbed editor pane (HTML/JS/CSS) with line numbers sits beside a live sandboxed iframe output, with a cyan glow status dot and a gradient wired Run button. features: gradient primary buttons + cyan glow dot
wired Run button renders sandboxed iframe
